title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay 12, City of Cabadbaran, Province of Agusan Del Norte to Be Known as Cabadbaran City National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay 12, City of Cabadbaran, Province of Agusan Del Norte to Be Known as Cabadbaran City National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay 12, Thành phố Cabadbaran, Tỉnh Agusan Del Norte được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Cabadbaran City
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ 12, เมือง Cabadbaran, จังหวัด Agusan Del Norte ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Cabadbaran City
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay 12, Kota Cabadbaran, Provinsi Agusan Del Norte dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Cabadbaran City
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay 12, Bandaraya Cabadbaran, Wilayah Agusan Del Norte dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Cabadbaran City

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. - There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay 12, City of Cabadbaran, Province of Agusan del Norte to be known as Cabadbaran City National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Cabadbaran City National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
